card.name: Inside drug and disease names
card.fires_on: Early pieces of long drug or disease names that are split into parts, such as Ta-let-rectinib, A-log-liptin and Th-al-idomide. It fires on the middle piece, before the rest of the name.

modes.label: Drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a split generic drug name that begins with a capital letter or a short stem.

modes.label: Disease and test names
modes.description: Middle piece of a split medical term such as thalassemia or thallium.

card.plain: It fires partway through long, unusual drug or disease names that the model reads in several pieces.
